name: log_error
description: Silently log one learner error for the end-of-session digest. The learner is not told. Call it at most once per learner turn. Never mention it aloud.

said.description: What the learner said, as transcribed.

corrected.description: The correct form, as a short phrase or sentence in the target language.

english.description: What the corrected form means, in English.

rule.description: One short sentence in English stating the rule. Optional.

breaks_comprehension.description: True only when the slip made the learner's meaning unclear.
